title: Initial layer instability of the kinetic Lamb-Oseen Vortex
summary: It is well-known that solutions to the incompressible Navier-Stokes system are limits in various contexts (weak or strong), of solutions to the Boltzmann equation, when the Mach and the Knudsen numbers go to zero. In particular the case of smooth solutions is by now rather well understood. Recent works have aimed at choosing initial data in function spaces as close as possible to those corresponding to well-posedness for the incompressible Navier-Stokes system.
